title: Dominic Sincere team up with Zoot for a new single "BL0W"
htmlContent:
Dominic Sincere teamed up with Zoot for his newest single "BL0W". The production brings a mainstream sound that gives it that worldwide appeal, that you know will help it travel around the world, and their vocal performance is masterful in it’s tone to match the energy needed to not only deliver the impressive writing, but make sure as many ears will hear this song as possible.

Dominic Sincere and Zoot brings an exciting sound to life on the new song “BL0W”. The music is incredible and filled with bright energy that, makes you fan out to the big time sound that stands out from everything you hear today.
